TaskList.title: TaskList
TaskList.description: A user-owned project or category list used to organize tasks and color-code calendar items.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent /users/{userId} path.

name.description: Display name of the list (1 to 60 characters).

colorHex.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) used for project category color coding.

iconKey.description: Identifier of the Material icon associated with this list.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every mutation.

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A personal to-do task assigned to a list, with a due date and optional push reminder timestamp.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent /users/{userId} path.

listId.description: Document ID of the parent TaskList under /users/{userId}/lists/{listId}.

notes.description: Optional additional notes for the task (0 to 1000 characters).

dueDateEpochDay.description: Local due date stored as LocalDate.toEpochDay() for timezone-stable grouping and calendar display.

reminderEpochMillis.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds when the local reminder notification should trigger.

completedAtEpochMillis.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds when the task was marked completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every mutation.

/users/{userId}/lists/{listId}.description: User-scoped collection of custom color-coded task lists.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-scoped collection of all personal tasks across all lists.
